title: Distinct products purchased per customer
prompt: Return each customer along with the number of distinct products they purchased, as columns customer and distinct_products.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE purchases7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer TEXT, product TEXT); INSERT INTO purchases7 VALUES (1,'Alice','Widget'),(2,'Alice','Widget'),(3,'Alice','Gadget'),(4,'Bob','Gadget'),(5,'Bob','Gizmo'),(6,'Bob','Gizmo'),(7,'Bob','Widget'),(8,'Carol','Gizmo');
reference_sql: SELECT customer, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS distinct_products FROM purchases7 GROUP BY customer;
